notes.title: Demo coming soon!
notes.notes: [p]Stay tuned for updates on the Demo being released this upcoming month. [/p][p]This first Demo version will feature the first 2 zones, a limited number of artifacts, scrolls, potions and playable characters, along with a few town upgrades.  [/p][p]Hopefully this first Demo will be long enough for players to get a taste of the combat and mechanics, so the game can receive some early feedback.  [/p][p]Thanks! [/p][p]Demo page: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3852140/DEFEAT_THE_GOBLIN_KING_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
